description: Find seed and pre-seed VC funds that are actively deploying capital right now, filtered by sector and optionally city. Use when a founder asks which VCs/investors are investing in a sector now, or for a seed investor list. Returns fund name, HQ, check size, why we believe it is deploying, and a DryPowder fund page link.

city.description: Optional HQ city, e.g. San Francisco, New York, London

sector.description: e.g. fintech, saas, ai, healthcare, climate, consumer, biotech, crypto

name: find_deploying_seed_funds
